title: Dyson Sphere: Desktop Factory Demo
description: Ignite your base on Tpler and forge your Dyson Sphere industrial wonder. Build automated desktop lines, deploy drone logistics, launch units to orbit. Draw tech perks for your build and boost output. Your custom Dyson Sphere orbit is exclusive live wallpaper, bringing cosmic romance to your desktop.

title: The Loomsong Chronicle Idle Demo
description: Lead a growing party through dangerous expeditions in this party-based idle RPG. Recruit, equip, train, gather, craft, and fight through level 25, then carry the same campaign into the full game without restarting.

title: The pilot always survives Demo
description: Control a helicopter, defend yourself from waves of enemies

title: 蛆之房 ~悬置之镜之歌~ Demo
description: Aliens turned humans into "maggots" – toiling underground, eating rotten flesh. Xingzhi has a house. Her and her tenants' fates are in your hands. Save Ku Yi? Follow Qi Qian? Each choice leads somewhere else. The road up is stained with blood. The answer is yours.

title: Slammer Soccer: Football Management Demo
description: Manage a prison football team, trade inmates, develop your squad, survive prison politics, and lead your team from the yard to glory.

title: Falafel Al Assad Demo
description: Do you have what it takes to serve the best Falafel in Moscow? Defy the elements in this whacky cooking sim and earn money to gain power-ups. Test your skills, and improve them to prepare for the final boss battle that will shake your world!

title: VICIOUS CIRCLE: The Way God Intended
description: Spiral into madness.

title: Zili Diary escape against witch Demo
description: Zili Diary is a psychological horror visual novel. Explore a cursed mall, make life-or-death choices, and fight to survive. Every action costs a piece of your soul.

title: Feastfall Demo
description: Feastfall is a cooking roguelike deckbuilder. Plate ingredient cards into recipes, stack game-breaking charm synergies, and feed ravenous monsters. This is not a kitchen sim. It's a life-or-death gamble at the dinner table — and the house is starving.

title: Prism Panic Demo
description: This is a free demo — play the first 10 waves. A fast-paced arcade shooter where you blast through waves of baddies, collect power-ups, survive curses, and chase the high score. Easy to pick up, hard to put down.

title: Drill Rover Demo
description: Drill Rover is an incremental game about mining walls in a foreign planet. Step on the gas, upgrade and go deep into the riches.

title: Void Ascend Demo
description: Push your limits in Void Ascend's physics-based, unforgiving climbing adventure! Grab ledges with precise timing, test your reflexes, and reach the peak in this relentless parkour where every mistake costs you dearly. Do you have the patience to reach the top?

title: Farm & Feast Demo
description: Grow fresh ingredients and run your own little restaurant. Enjoy a peaceful day that stretches from the field to the table. Plan a fresh menu for a delightful day, keep your pantry full, and make your customers happy. Earn your own money and build your little world step by step.

title: Gas Station Simulator Demo
description: A gas station and convenience store tycoon. Stock shelves, pump fuel, and ring up sales. Grow from a humble roadside stall by pricing stock and unlocking licenses to upgrade your shop. Set out every product by hand, tidy up what customers leave behind, and grow a thriving business.

title: Delivery Survivors Demo
description: Delivery Survivors is a survivor-like action roguelite game. Gather powerful relics and weapons, level up your character, create unique builds and slaughter your way through endless minions and bosses in the dungeon.

title: Heart Decay Demo
description: Heart Decay is a story-driven turn-based strategy game featuring 32-bit pixel art visuals. Execute lethal counter-attacks with precise timing during reaction windows that open during enemy moves. Shape your destiny in a dark world defined by a rich narrative.

title: Blotch Demo
description: Blotch is a stealth game about hiding from guards by painting yourself the exact color of the floor. Take the color under your feet, paint it over yourself, hold still, and let them walk right over the top of you. Thirty-two hand-made levels, plus online hide-and-seek.

title: Fishcremental Demo
description: Fishcremental is a ridiculously cozy underwater adventure where you catch super cute fish, discover game-changing upgrades, and fill the whole sea with satisfying firework glory.

title: CyberRushUasSimulator Demo
description: 专业的无人机仿真模拟训练软件，为新手与进阶飞手提供安全、高效的训练平台。软件内置标准化科目考核体系，覆盖基础操作，训练场景；同时提供多套丰富逼真的训练环境，全方位还原真实飞行体验。软件支持键盘、手柄等多种操作方式，无需实体无人机即可完成从入门到精通的全流程训练，大幅降低学习成本与安全风险。

title: Sideways Motorways Demo
description: Turns and corners? No thank you! In this traffic-simulation game all roads are straight and cars never brake. A smart city planner like you would do the sensible thing and move the houses around instead, to avoid intersections. Or would you rather take the thrill of a close call for a higher score?

title: Ectorider Demo
description: Ectorider is a fast-paced 3D platformer combining Extreme Sports and Third Person Shooter. Fight a robot army with your super magnet or use them to do insane tricks with your rollerblades. Save the Ectomorphs and stop Professor Ecto's evil plan.

title: Helion Conflict Demo
description: The free demo of Helion Conflict - and during Steam Next Fest it's the full game, with nothing locked. Capture shipyards, split fleets by exact percentage, turn them in mid-flight. Up to eight online. Minutes, not hours.

title: LumberBoy Demo
description: A woodcutting incremental where you explore different forests, process wood, and keep growing. Start with just a basic axe, max out your stats, and become the greatest lumberjack in the forest!

title: Oneiric Voyage Demo
description: [Oneiric Voyage] is a creature-collecting adventure game with single and multiplayer.Explore alone or team up with global players to catch and bond with 123 unique spirits.Enjoy our special fun mode for a brand-new experience.

title: NodeFeat Demo
description: Still reading? No time to talk. TO THE FRONT. A phosphorescent swarm is devouring everything in its path and Node 52 is next. Your base is a tree: grow it, turn it, dig in, HOLD. A million, a billion, who cares. Kill them all.

title: 起業×経営体験ゲーム『おいでよ！スタートアップ村』 Demo
description: This is a free demo version of the full game. In the demo, you can play from the startup phase through Turn 10 of the management phase. Oideyo Startup Mura is a simulation game that lets you experience the challenges and excitement of starting and running your own business.

title: SoundRoom Demo
description: Guess the type of instrument being played.

title: Misery Dungeon Demo
description: This is the demo version of Misery Dungeon. It's a standalone part of the experience, completely spoiler free. Get a free glimpse of the horrors contained in the Ktol'maa Mountain.

title: MORROWTAPE Demo
description: A first-person psychological horror game set beneath a condemned 1989 telephone archive. Tune impossible calls, evade a creature that hunts every sound you make, and decide which evidence the city is allowed to remember.

title: Boarding House: Night Shift Demo
description: Boarding House: Night Shift — Welcome to the Night ShiftWelcome to your new job. Be careful... because your first night might be your last.We are proud to introduce Boarding House: Night Shift, a survival horror experience that takes you into a remote boarding house hidden deep in the mountains, where a simple night job slowly turns into...

title: Orca Gril: Idle Fishing Story Demo
description: Fish, farm, and build your island alongside adorable Orca Girls! A cozy idle game that runs at the bottom or in any corner of your screen while you work or study. Collect rare and exotic fish, then create and decorate your own fantasy pixel-art aquariums.

title: Carnival Stand Simulator Demo
description: Grill it. Load it. Hand it over. Carnival Stand Simulator drops you behind the counter of a midway hot dog stand where the line never really ends. Serve fast, sell out, and build the busiest pitch at the carnival.

title: DOPA-MATCH3: Cosmic Journey Demo
description: The best-feeling match-3 game in the universe. Line up three gems and let them vanish with a twinkle. Fill the HEAT gauge and the ultimate combo time begins. Clear the LEVEL, pick an upgrade card, and grow permanently stronger for the long journey ahead.

title: 三天 Demo
description: 由真实经历改编的叙事视觉小说。宝宝出生前三天，一位新手爸爸在产房外学着成为父亲。日常之下，每一个选择都在改写他与妻子、家人之间的关系。完整版单次流程约一小时（DEMO仅包含序章内容）。

title: Duck Fest Demo
description: Try Duck Fest: classic playing cards meet strategic 1v1 battles! Use card effects and well-timed passes to claim the flag. Enjoy the story’s opening and online friend matches. Steam Community Market card trading is exclusive to the full game.

title: SCOP Demo
description: A roguelite twist on classic Italian Scopa. Build powerful combinations with Relics and Marks, visit Shops, defeat escalating Blind and Boss encounters, and experience the first three RUNS before continuing your journey in the full game.

title: Kyoumei Demo
description: Fight alongside Kannagi Mashiro, your childhood friend and a mysterious shrine maiden from a parallel world, to save your world in this 2D anime action game with visual novel storytelling.

title: Audionaut Demo
description: This demo is a small, playable version of Audionaut, a 2D music composition spaceship autobattler.

title: Clicker Inc.～世代交代で目指す巨大企業～ Demo
description: 代替わりで強くなる経営クリッカーゲーム！最初はクリックでコツコツ稼ぎ、社員を雇って自動で収益が上がる不労所得システムを構築。株、銀行、オークションを活用して、バブル到来と崩壊の波を乗りこなそう。社長の寿命が来たら世代交代（転生）のとき！100以上のスキルで次世代を強化し、さらに稼げる体制へ。大量の実績コンプリートや歴代社長の歩みを振り返る年譜機能も満載。小さな一打を皮切りに、何代にもわたって経営のバトンを繋ぎ、世界を動かす巨大企業を作り上げよう！ ※本ゲームは『Clicker Inc. ～世代交代で目指す巨大企業～』の体験版です。4回目の転生までがプレイできます。

title: 弾幕乱舞 ― バレットバラージュ ― Demo
Age of Sail Demo
description: Age of Sail is a boat combat game that revolves around killing pirates (or other players.)  You can upgrade your cannons to have up to 5 on each side.  You can sell loot to replenish health and ammo.

title: Penguin Weapons Demo
description: Penguin Weapons is a dynamic action roguelite about penguins that collect artifacts, creating absurdly crazy weapons, fight monsters and bosses, unlock stylish clothes, and explore increasingly difficult worlds full of unique combinations and unpredictability alone or with friends.

title: Mega Sokofox World Demo
description: Help Sara, the fox, overcome anxiety and leave her comfy labyrinth, to visit her beloved vampire girlfriend in this 16-bit Sokoban Adventure for the Mega Drive!

title: Find The Needle Demo
description: You have a shovel and a haystack with about six million strands in it. Somewhere inside there's a needle. Dig it out by hand, sell the hay, then spend the money on belts and machines until you don't have to dig anymore.

title: Grimhold Demo
description: Demo of Grimhold, a dark-fantasy tower defense roguelike: play the entire first act and command three unique heroes. Hold the wall, reshape every run, and wishlist the full game.

title: Ordinary People Demo
description: Ordinary People is a game about building a cozy little town at the bottom of your screen, keeping you company while you work or study.  As you build your town, Ordinary People will begin to move in, interacting with one another in some not-so-Ordinary ways.

title: SlapBox: Audio Tools Demo
description: SlapBox: Audio Tools Demo lets you import and record audio, use the waveform editor, preview effects in real time, and explore the core SlapBox workflow.Demo limitations: Audio export, keyframing, and saving or loading .slap project files are available in the full version only.

title: Fireworks Incremental Demo
description: Bad Wizard covered the land with a Magical Dome and the only way to destroy it is with fireworks! Hire units, unlock buildings, buy upgrades, discover powerful synergies, turn a few tiny explosions into a ridiculous spectacle and ultimately defeat The Bad Wizard himself!

title: GEOMETRY NEXUS Demo
description: Geometry Nexus is a neon action roguelike where your weapons fire automatically. Dodge enemy swarms, collect upgrades, trigger Overdrive, grow stronger between runs, and survive ten minutes to defeat the Nexus Guardian.

title: Zœufs Story Academie Demo
description: Raise a Zanmi egg at the "Academie des Zœufs". Care for it, choose its activities and training, and build relationships with the other students to shape its growth in this character-raising simulation. What kind of Zanmi will you raise?

title: Tile Blast - Puzzle Game Demo
description: Tile Blast Demo lets you experience the addictive Classic Mode for free. Place blocks, clear lines, chase high scores, and get a taste of the full Tile Blast experience, featuring Time Mode, Duel Mode, skins, cases, and more.

title: Cité Alexandrie Demo
developer: Sirène Rouge Games, La Belle Games

title: Starfinder: Afterlight Demo
description: Starfinder: Afterlight is a party-based RPG that brings Paizo's beloved science-fantasy universe to life. Battle across the Pact Worlds, lead a legendary crew where your choices shape their destiny, and well, save the galaxy while you're at it!

title: Gun a Rat Demo
description: Don’t like rats? Don’t like your friends? Then this game is made for you! Hunt down the rats before they wreck the place, and methodically place your traps to slow them down as much as possible!

title: Black Ball Demo
description: It's normal for this game to have bugs because it's outdated. The demo only has 30 levels, and more will be announced.

title: Black Hole Surfers Demo
description: Trapped after being sucked into a black hole, your only hope is to gather resources from the passing debris, upgrade your ship and survive long enough to find a way to escape. A unique blend of bullet-heaven action and incremental upgrading, will you find your way back home in Black Hole Surfers?

title: Gunship Incremental Demo
description: A fast-paced incremental game about operating a gunship and defending your tower. Master precisely timed rockets, upgrade your gunship and obliterate hordes of enemies and unique bosses.

title: IT MOVES! - Build Your Own Robot Demo
description: LIMITED-CONTENT DEMO: Play the four opening contracts of IT MOVES! Time a piston, choose the right drive for heavy loads, coordinate a gate and stamp, and assemble your first wheeled robot.

title: Mimic in the Dungeon Demo
description: You are the Tentacle Mimic! Build your dungeon and lure female adventurers inside. Recruit them for your harem to harness their energy and grow stronger.

title: Froggous Grove Demo
description: Raise little cube-shaped frogs in a voxel marsh you bring back to life. Collect flies, hatch eggs to discover 82 species, clear away the trash and redecorate every corner however you like. A gentle life sim with no pressure.

title: Bob BOBBED Bob... Demo
developer: Adam and Simmons (Isaac Ward & Julian Ward)

title: Delenar TD: Remastered Demo
description: Delenar TD Remastered is an old school Grid based Tower Defense game, where you control the path of the mobs. Build towers, place mazing rocks, and adapt to the mobs in each level. The strategy of solving each level is completely up to you!

title: Twilight Gallery Demo
description: A point-and-click puzzle game inspired by flash games of the early internet. Escape a dream-like gallery using a magic helm to look for clues and uncover how you got here.

title: Courage and Faith: Into the Dark Woods Demo
description: A dark, atmospheric party-based RPG where you form an expedition, make difficult choices, manage tension, and fight tactical turn-based battles. AI-generated narration reacts to your decisions, making each journey into the forest feel distinct.

title: Desktop Slime Graveyard: Tap Reaper Demo
Logic Arrows Demo
description: Logic Arrows is a sandbox game where you design your own mechanisms: from logic gates to an entire computer. Use simple elements to build complex systems, solve engineering challenges and master computer logic.

title: Save the Forest Demo
description: Save the Forest is a tactics roguelite where you lead your squad of villagers in a quest to defeat the admittedly pretty silly evil that has corrupted the forest. Choose and create combos with over 25 units and 150+ skills!

title: Outcast Tales Demo
description: Assemble a squad of characters with robust personalities and abilities, and their relationships unfold. Engage in deep tactical battles, make tough decisions, and choose your own adventures - write an Outcast Tale that’s unique to you!

title: Atlanta TD Demo
description: Call upon the Gods of Olympus to defend Atlanta from Ares’ invading hordes in this roguelite tower defense epic. Unlock powerful upgrades, discover the God's, and shape the fate of a new Pantheon!

title: [Demo] Minesweeper Scapes
description: Mine Density: over 30%!? The overwhelming Minesweeper Challenge awaits you!! Deadlock? : Breakthrough with Items and Magics! Various ❝Scapes❞ presents you unprecedented trials!

title: Tongo Demo
description: Try the TONGO Demo and discover a roguelike bingo where you build a deck, manipulate probability, and turn luck into strategy. Experiment with powerful cards, create synergies, and get your first taste of TONGO.

title: Blobby Bash Demo
description: BOUNCE, BATTLE AND BASH your friends in this fast paced movement party game demo! Engage in 7 different game modes where winning requires speed, strategy and skill

title: CPU: Computing Potatoes Unlimited Demo
description: Program potato workers to process numbers with simple punch-in instructions at a factory that mimics a processor. Optimize solutions to solve challenging open-ended puzzles. Punch, observe, learn, repeat.

title: The Endless Harvest Demo
description: The Endless Harvest is an idle village-builder crossed with a tower defense. Build a farm that earns money on its own, invest it in towers and upgrades, and survive waves of raiders that grow stronger every round. Production continues while the game is closed — how far will you get?

title: Cricket Team Manager Demo
description: The full game, stopped after five matches. Pick any of the twelve Test nations, name your squad, choose your captains, then play out every ball. Same engine, same database, same fixtures. It ends mid-series, and a demo career does not carry into the full game.

title: VYCE (DEMO)
description: VYCE is an upcoming tactical RPG where you collect and trade critters based on real-world vices that move like chess pieces. Experience the first act and Value Your Choices Effectively in this unorthodox amalgamation of strategy and depravity.

title: Bar Baron: Restaurant & Nightlife Tycoon Demo
Aviator Beta Demo
description: Take your first steps into the Jet Age. Build your airline, expand your fleet, launch profitable routes, and outmaneuver rivals as you grow from a local carrier into an ambitious aviation empire.

title: Heaven Miner Demo
description: Find outfits, fall in love with angels, and build a harem! Start a relaxing journey in Heaven Miner and build a unique harem.

title: Dungeon Automata Demo
description: Dungeon Automata「Algolemeth」is an "autologic": a JRPG dungeon crawler meets auto battler where you control your party with visual node-based programming. Program your party and conquer dungeons automatically. Master the dungeon through trial and error!

title: Camp Manager Simulator (Demo)
description: Take over a small lakeside campsite in this free demo. Pitch tents, light campfires, and welcome your first campers, then run the reception, sell supplies, and earn enough to unlock your first expansion. Your camping business starts here.

title: 万象回廊：元素 Wanxiang Corridor: Elements Demo
description: Wanxiang Corridor: Elements is a 2D roguelike action shooter. Wield a bow through procedurally generated corridors, switching between Water and Ice to trigger Freeze and stun your foes. Clear rooms, pick randomized buffs, forge your build across five stages. Pixel art, a fresh run every time.
developer: 黄涛, 谭嘉辉, 伍尚演, 小入想睡觉

title: Worker Survival Simulator Demo
description: Each run starts at your apartment, then moves through the rush-hour subway to the office. The office is the game’s core, with seven functional spots offering different rewards and risks. KPI progress, boss patrols, colleague events, and random incidents make every workday unique.

title: Doomsday Landlord Demo
description: A post-apocalyptic management game with a streak of absurd humor. Take in Survivors, build Rooms, expand your Base, merge Rooms, manage each run's resources, and keep it all running while completing Survival Plans and weathering Zombie Hordes.

title: She Tells Her Story Demo
description: A visual novel that details the author's experience growing up, covering topics such as friendship, bullying, romance, school, work, and depression.

title: ODD ODDS Demo
description: A single-player roguelike gambling game set entirely in one room. To clear a crushing debt, win coins at the claw machine, cash out at the ATM, and upgrade at the typewriter before the devil collects. Then the doorbell rings. Ally, or scammer? Who you deal with decides whether you get out.

title: Misohagi Crossing Demo
description: On his first visit to his father's rural hometown in seven years, Hotaru reunites with his first love—only to learn that she died three years ago. Explore Yokomizo, uncover the truth behind a family tragedy, and escape supernatural otherworlds in this Japanese horror mystery adventure.

title: Ghost in the SQL Data Demo
description: Somebody reported the fire fourteen minutes before it started. Prove it in real SQL. Learn the language from your first line, question a live evidence database, and let the records name the culprit for you.

title: TransGenDeer Demo
description: Demo Version of TransGenDeer a "Educational Game" to fight transphobia. So habe fun playing the game.

title: BACKBITE Demo
description: Snake, but as a duel. Two snakes, one board, five powers to sabotage each other. Try the full duel against the bot or with someone next to you on the same computer: all five powers and the 15-second chase are here, uncut.

title: Just One Bite Demo
description: A survival horror game you can play alone or with up to 4 players. Gather as much food as possible to survive and grow stronger. But not all food is normal.

title: Gold Seller Demo
description: You owe 47 million won. The only way out is selling in-game gold for real cash. Haggle in group chats, demand payment upfront, get scammed — or do the scamming. Drive that balance to zero.

title: Satelital Demo
description: A rule-discovery puzzle game where you place alien symbols on a grid. Uncover their logic as you journey through an atmospheric solar system.

title: Toy Battles Demo
description: Build a squad of toys, stack buffs, and chain game-breaking combos in this roguelite auto battler. Unlock something new each run, endless synergies awaits — break the game!

title: Waifu Bubble Demo
description: Dive into the first 6 levels of Waifu Bubble! Play solo or with a friend, guide adorable crabs, solve relaxing two-layer puzzles, and help a waifu trapped in a bubble make her way from the depths of the ocean to the surface.

title: My VTuber Rival is Actually Cute?! Demo
description: Fall for your VTuber rival in this modern slice-of-life yuri visual novel!

title: Extravalence Demo
description: Lead a party of living chemical elements through a fractured world where every bond changes the battle. Switch between unique heroes, combine their abilities, manage volatile reactions and restore the stability.

title: Bouncy Ball Battle Demo
description: Bouncy Ball Battle is a chaotic, turn-based online multiplayer game where physics meets strategy. Break through blocks to open up lines of attack, line up your shots, and bounce off walls to knock out your opponents and be the last ball standing!

title: Under the Bridge Demo
description: Return to Bridge City, where you'll meet and date junkyard friends. Hear their stories, have an adventure, and maybe even fall in love!

title: VOIDHOLD: Squad Survival Roguelite Demo
description: A sci-fi horde-survival roguelite. Lead a four-soldier fireteam, a combat dog and an eagle-drone against endless escalating waves. Chain run-altering synergies and hold the line across the demo's first two biomes.

title: The Clues Demo
description: The Clues is a challenging logic deduction game set in Paw Town. Play as a cat detective, read the clues, and identify every Criminal and Innocent. No guessing, no luck—every handcrafted puzzle has a unique solution.

title: Meridian Strike Demo
description: Command a mercenary mech company in a turn-based tactical RPG. Plan every move on a hex battlefield, manage heat and localized damage, develop your pilots, repair battered machines, and experience the opening operation of Meridian Strike.

title: abducted Demo
description: You've been abducted by aliens and you need to find your way back to earth. Fight lots of different robots on the mother ship. Every level is randomly generated. And you can only carry a few weapons, so choose them wisely. Use combinations of weapons to defeat the robot bosses. Good luck, don't die!

title: Iskarn Demo
description: Build and defend a medieval colony in a vast, infinite voxel world. Gather resources, craft gear, train citizens, and survive brutal zombie hordes. Dig deep, explore wild biomes, and turn a handful of survivors into a thriving settlement.

title: Sunrise Demo
description: Sunrise is a 2D platformer high-speed hack and slash, featuring the ability to create and share levels you make to the world!

title: ChessWorlds: Grandmaker Demo
description: ChessWorlds: Grandmaker is a puzzle game in which you design chess pieces using code blocks, and solve puzzles with your newly created army. Run a piece making shop, battle unique opponents, solve puzzles in different worlds with changed rules, and uncover the mistery behind the Grandmaker.

title: Impact Zero Project Demo
description: SURVIVE. ADAPT. AVOID IMPACT.Impact Zero is a fast-paced 3D obstacle survival game where coordination, timing, and momentum are the difference between winning and losing.Take control of a cube and navigate increasingly challenging environments filled with moving obstacles, lasers, shifting platforms, difficult jumps, and unpredictable...

title: Dough Boys Demo
description: Dough Boys is the only class-based shooter where dying for pizza toppings never felt this good. Gear up, drop into the battlefield, and unleash hell with authentic Cold War firepower. Fight shoulder-to-shoulder with your brothers in arms.

title: BASIC PARADE or: "you should be depressed." Demo
We Are Cooking Demo
description: Grab your apron and enjoy chaotic cooking action with your friends or solo! Prepare dishes before time runs out and prove yourself a worthy chef.

title: Bombseeker Demo
description: A minesweeper you have to walk. Step on a tile to learn what surrounds it, spend flags you paid for to cross what you cannot test, and get from the entrance to the exit alive. Fifteen fixed boards across three regions, approximately 1/3 of the full games levels. However, the full game bites back,

title: Evo Ascension Demo
description: A fast‑paced top‑down arena survival game where you battle evolving enemies, level up, and build powerful stat paths to push your run toward true ascension.

title: Rogue Paper Scissors Demo
description: The first act of Rogue Paper Scissors, free. Eight floors, three hybrids, and the extraction gamble: bank your loot or push one floor deeper. Ends on a miniboss that is a mirror of your own deck.

title: Mariana Marina Demo
description: Repair boats and deliver goods in the Marianas for reals.

title: BREACH Demo
description: BREACH is a fast-paced action psychological Horror FPS set inside the facilities of Helix Construct Systems.You are a test subject.Trapped inside an experimental facility with no clear way out, you will have to fight, run, and improvise your way through a series of increasingly dangerous Chambers. Every room is designed to test you.

title: Pistonica Demo
description: Pistonica is the pure steam and mechanical factory automation game, challenging your resource management skills. Explore the tropical island first-person, research tech, mine for minerals, build contraptions and trade goods - all because of a strange radio signal.

title: Wall of Symbols Demo
description: A roguelite siege defense played on an alchemist's table. Spin, place, and let symbols ripen into forms your deck never held. Every neighbour feeds the next, and one transmute turns the whole board into damage.

title: Nowhere Demo
description: Experience NOWHERE's prologue and the opening of Chapter 1, from Kim Yoohan's childhood to the discovery of a murder at a convenience store. Uncover his past and present while learning observation, deduction, crime-scene investigation, and Absolute Memory.

title: Maid Supremacy: Achieving World Domination with a Tank! Demo
description: A 3D action-shooter campaign about maids controlling a drifting tank with multiple weapon extensions! Destroy those filthy uncultured girls and prove that MAIDS ARE BETTER, alone or with your friends! Personalize your tank and unlock even more parts!

title: Contract of the ninja Demo
description: Contract of the Ninja is a stealth arcade game. Study enemy routes, strike with precision, and escape without being seen. Master precise controls, optimize your path, and complete contracts with maximum efficiency in fast, challenging stages.

title: This Little World: Future Sound of Bristol Demo
description: Future Sound of Bristol is a playable demo, featuring 1000km² of Bristol and Bath, presenting procedural music and audio systems used in This Little World, a forthcoming open-world game about exploring and rebuilding Britain, with mini-games themed on the 2025 Audio Developer Conference.

title: Faultfinder Demo
description: Seven incidents. One machine. The engineer who kept it running is dead. Step through her rune-tape, set breakpoints and rewind its execution, then name the line that killed her and the fault it carried. The free demo of a deduction game where the crime scene is a program.

description: Rural Nostalgia, Chinese Horror, Realistic 3D Graphics, Jump Scares, Chase Sequences, Psychological Horror, Logical Deduction, Mechanism Puzzles

title: 黑哨 DirtyRef Demo
description: This is not just a football game! As the referee, we don't need fairness! We only want money! Buy lottery tickets, use dirty off-field tactics and contacts, and use your status as referee to become a billionaire! "It's not personal, it's business."

title: The Moonless Bell Demo

description: The demo for Crownfront, a turn-based strategy game played on a board on the floor of a room. One map against one AI kingdom. Gather wood and food, build farms and barracks, raise an army and take the enemy castle. A full match, start to finish.

title: Space Battle Cats Demo
description: SpaceBattleCats is a frantic space shooter where you fight off alien hordes by matching your weapon colors to your enemies. Pilot the CATNIC solo or in local co-op, manage real-time repairs, tackle wild minigames, and protect the feline mothership through the cosmos!

title: Shrine Full of Anomalies Demo
description: A Touhou Project fan-made anomaly-spotting game. Control Reimu Hakurei and inspect the shrine grounds. If you find an anomaly, turn back. If everything looks normal, ring the bell at the worship hall. A wrong choice sends you back to the start. The demo includes Stage 1.

title: Kairos Demo
description: Build, expand, and wage dice-driven wars in this medieval 4x strategy game played in under an hour. Adopt unique legacies to progressively define your strategy as you race your rivals to accomplish 5 feats and claim victory.

title: Rising Above It Demo
description: Climb freely through dynamic environments using a physics‑driven movement system. Every route is a puzzle of stamina, grip, and precision. Explore, experiment, and push your limits in a vertical world built for skill, creativity, and challenge.

title: Timber! Idle Village Builder Demo
description: Swing your axe, drop the trees, and watch a village rise from the stumps. Assign villagers to nine trades, unlock a 54-node talent tree, and carry your settlement through five ages — from a primitive camp to a medieval kingdom with a crown of its own.

title: Cat Gunner Demo
description: Custom level blending Worlds 1 & 2, with six random modifiers and a new modifier each attempt.

title: Three Kingdoms:Explosive Battle Demo
description: A side-scrolling “roguelike” combat game set in the Three Kingdoms era, featuring three classes to choose from: Warrior, Mage, and Archer. Each class offers two progression paths. With flashing blades and punches that pack a punch, come experience the thrill of combat!

title: Me VS Demonking?Seriously?  Demo
description: This is a proper auto-battler game... right? Aside from the characters being a bit odd, the equipment a bit bizarre, and the skills a bit baffling... everything else seems pretty normal.

title: Escape the Space Hotel Demo
description: Stranded in a luxury space hotel orbiting 400 km above Earth, Max Reed must solve mind-bending puzzles to survive. Explore stunning zero-gravity decks, hack systems, and make life-or-death choices in this classic 2D point-and-click sci-fi adventure packed with 100+ clever puzzles, can you Escape?

title: Fuse Beads Simulator ~ Debt Payoff Story Demo
description: Create and sell various pieces of art using fuse beads. Earn money to cover your daily expenses and pay off your debts

title: Nine Winters Demo
description: Explore a ruined city for food and materials, then return to your shelter to cook, make repairs, and settle in. Craft furniture, change the wallpaper and flooring, and take care of a stray cat that comes by. The demo can be played through the first winter.

title: ApocalypseHQ Demo
description: Command a survivor headquarters through its first 20 days in this turn-based management strategy demo. Balance people and supplies, restore essential infrastructure, research new options, and send squads on risky external operations.

title: Misplaced Demo
description: Misplaced is an archival deduction game. Draw documents from a disordered case file and use the clues on each filing slot to determine where they belong. Once every document is correctly filed, begin verification, connect the clues, and uncover the truth.

title: Farmer=nil Demo
description: Farmer = nil is a programming automation farm game. Write scripts for your robots, collect resources, unlock tech, and build the most efficient farm.

title: Junior Birder Adventure Demo
description: This is a demo for Junior Birder Adventure. Embark on a nature adventure to uncover the vibrant avian life of Southeast Asia in its natural habitats.

title: Night Portable Demo
description: A free demo of Night Portable, a night-shift survival horror set in a 2000s secondhand game store. Clean, restock, and survive until 6 AM. Play three retro handheld games to earn items for the 3D store. The threat keeps moving while you play.

title: Rawbogem DEMO
description: Welcome to the Rawbogem DEMO. A taste of the single-player brawler packed with parries, swift combat, and pre-fight upgrades that shapes every battle. Step into the boots of Iron Bessie, a one-woman army tearing through the Dur Crew to bring down their leader, Baja Steele.

title: Project Spooky Demo
description: The developer vanished before finishing this game. Play a reconstruction of his final project and uncover what happened inside a house that doesn't want you to leave. The more you understand its rules, the more terrifying it becomes.

title: Skymote Demo
description: A tower defence deckbuilder with roguelike elements. Build a deck, raise towers, cast spells, and discover unexpected synergies to turn your floating island into a fortress the sky can't break.

title: Qu Adra Demo
description: Qu Adra” is a single‑player, 2D horror tabletop‑style game. Experience a deadly game of memory created by “Adra,” born from a warped ideology.

title: MiniCook Demo
description: MiniCook is a cozy life simulation game about running food stalls, serving customers, earning money, and discovering new ways of living. Experience the charm of city life through cooking, business, and personal growth.

title: Quadra Break: Variations Demo
description: Quadra Break: Variations lets you switch off your brain and shatter a whole screenful of blocks into pieces. You can even play Go and poker with blocks.

title: Code Blue Idle Demo
description: A medical idle game with real hospital depth. Treat patients, hire staff, and unlock departments from the ED to the ICU — then watch your hospital run itself while you sleep.

title: EXCISA Demo
description: Take a seat in the EXCISA demo. Choose a tarot card. Decide how many dice to roll. Advance the ritual toward the Angel while five uninvited guests may answer your call. Win the séance—and decide whether to stand up or stay seated.

title: Battle Runes of Metalaria Demo
description: Battle Runes of Metalaria is an action packed, chaos infused board game for up to four players. Stack your runes on the board to make vertical and horizontal combos or smash your opponents pieces to smithereens

title: Small Fry Demo
description: Cook any meal you can imagine! Invent new ways to delight your customer’s taste buds, refine your menu to use your ingredients efficiently, and put it all together without missing an order. Unlock new ingredients and kitchen gadgets to create more and more perfect culinary creations.

title: Titan Bash Demo
description: Jump into Titan Bash, a vehicle combat game featuring armed vehicles, explosive battles, enemy encounters, power-ups, and local split-screen co-op. This demo offers a playable introduction to the core combat experience.

title: MECHMASH Demo
description: A fast-paced 3D survivor where you build a combat robot through powerful Resonances. Combine weapons, orbitals and elemental cores into new attack forms, dash through relentless mechanical hordes, and turn each run into escalating screen-clearing mayhem.

title: Genius Simulator Demo
description: **Play a god-tier genius whose subtle glance is misread as the world's salvation formula!** In this deck-building Roguelike, turn fanatical overthinking into strategy: observe your opponent's mental flaws, shatter their logic chain, or strike their blind spots for an instant kill!

title: Night Hazard Demo
description: A Demo for the Dark Fantasy Action Hack N' Slash RPG Night Hazard. Experience the first area of the game - The Dark Kingdom of Golgotha. Awaken from your slumber and ride for the great Castle Golgotha and defeat the evil lurking within.

title: Go! Super Awesome Monkey! Demo
description: Play as SAM in Go! Super Awesome Monkey and save the world from AI Tech Overlords in this cute 3D Platformer! Collect pizza slices, coins, & floppy discs by spinning, dashing, and slamming (and more!) in a variety of levels. Play at your own pace: explore or speedrun to rise up the leaderboards!

title: Mithril Demo
description: Explore and mine in procedural caves. Master using struts to delve deeper and support the ceiling before it falls. Build automation chains to process ores. Then manipulate lava and trigger Dormancy to crystallise new ore where lava once flowed. Same world. New cave. New dangers. The world remembers.

title: Rail Capital Demo
description: A real-time train company strategy game, this demo features one playable scenario and three tutorial missions. The full game's features include a rogue-lite campaign game, scripted missions, Game of the Day, multiplayer and sandbox scenarios.

title: K-God Robot Hunters Demo
description: A Korean-fantasy poker roguelike where goddesses reshape every hand.

title: OtherWorld: Infinite Loop Demo
description: Stranded in a strange world. Explore. Survive. Find your way home. Death is inevitable, but every rebirth makes you stronger. In this text-based incremental game, choose your actions, plan your path, and uncover the truth behind the world.

title: Whoever Left the Light On Demo
description: You don't know who you are. You don't know where you are. You don't know when you are. A POV surreal puzzle game where dream logic replaces the rules you know... Explore a shifting stylised world, outwit its impossible puzzles, and piece together who you were before you woke here.

title: 多元幸存者 Diverse survivors Demo
description: Diverse survivors is a 2D top-down solo ARPG horde survival game. Fight monster swarms, enchant single skills, loot random affix gear and unlock set bonuses with full armor sets. Make unique builds, explore multiverse dungeons alone and grow strong with gear enchantment systems.

title: Inferno Demo
description: Run, jump, dash, explore and FIRE in this 16-bit platformer.

title: I WILL BE THERE: Remastered Edition Demo
Shadows of Christmas Eve Demo
description: A narrative psychological horror adventure set during Christmas. Explore a nightmare, follow the clues, and find a way to escape.

title: Ubernetz Demo
description: A hacking themed turn-based strategy game demo. Write scripts to move your agent. Eliminate or make use of virus and anti-virus to take over your target's device. Then hop around the network until you find your target.

title: Eredian Stronghold Demo
description: Dive into this fast-paced ARPG where you push lanes, capture buildings, manage your economy and find legendary loot. Create your own builds and become a God of Eredian Stronghold!

title: The Ape Tales - DEMO
description: Step into the shoes of a heroic ape in The Ape Tales, an epic 2D action-adventure! Try the free demo to experience combat across different eras, unique weaponry, and intense boss battles. If you're up for the challenge, jump into The Ape Tales today!

title: For My Kingdom Demo
description: You are a medieval king. Keep your treasury, army, granary and church in balance with every decision. Repel invaders on the war map, pass the throne to your heir, grow your dynasty for generations.

title: Cluckopia Demo
description: You are Tuti, a rooster searching for his sister. The demo features the entire first valley and the first 18 missions: building rooms, farming, cooking with the hens, and a bit of combat. If you enjoy it, the full game is available to wishlist on the page.

title: MANIFEST Demo
description: This is a game about the pressure of keeping ships productive. Idle ships bleed money. Late deliveries hurt your reputation. Old hulls develop histories. Captains become known quantities. A quiet ore run can suddenly become a rescue problem, a customs problem, or a piracy problem.

title: Corner Miner Demo
description: Corner Miner is a tiny mine that lives on your desktop while you work, study, watch videos or do anything else. Keep it running in the background, check in whenever you feel like it, or take control and mine everything yourself.

title: Flippin' Bottles Demo
description: Flip bottles, stack earnings, and turn a tiny tabletop trick into an automated idle machine. Buy bigger bottles, unlock helpers and prestige for permanent upgrades.

title: REaffraid Demo
description: REAFFRAID is a THIRD person SURVIVAL HORROR game where you FIGHT Soldiers, Robots, Zombies and SEXY demon girls with powerful weapons and hand to hand fighting techniques.

title: Day 31 Demo
description: You're already infected. The suppressant is the only thing holding it back, and it runs out on Day 31. Fight through St. Harrow's Hospital wave by wave, trade nerve to a masked thing that calls itself a merchant, and try to see morning.

title: Damage Numbers Go Brr! Demo
description: Damage Numbers Go Brr! is a chill incremental auto battler. Watch small numbers turn into absurdly huge numbers as you defeat enemies, get stronger, and vibe to the music while damage numbers fill your screen.

title: Last Contract Demo
description: Last Contract is a fast-paced 2D action game set in a pixelated cyberpunk world where katanas, shurikens, and quick reflexes are your key to survival.

title: NodeRise Demo
description: Solve beam puzzles as a memory-wiped robot trapped in a mysterious system. Place and rotate nodes, activate the walls, and rise through increasingly complex levels. The NodeRise Demo includes the first 10 levels of the game.

title: Eye, caramba! (Demo)
description: The demo is the same as the base game except it has only 12 levels to solve. It also has 2 achievements.

title: Cosmo Corgis Demo
description: Scout is a terrible pilot, but he loves corgis. Gather, upgrade, repair the ship and rescue a corgi on each of the demo's 3 planets, then bring those little chaos beings home in the full game. Runs at the bottom of your desktop while you work or in a window when work is optional. Saves carry over.

title: PRIDEBLOOD -Born of Claws- Demo
description: The free demo of a monster raising and breeding sim. Play one full in-game year — 48 weeks. You never see a monster's ceiling, and you never touch a battle. Four continents, 99 rival owners, over 3,000 monsters — some 400 born the same year as yours, all ageing and competing without you.

title: Binary Proof Demo
description: Test Specialist Aaron Blonde finds himself in the midst of uncanny and strange events during a routine workday. In this facility where the boundaries of logic are pushed, he must use every detail of his environment to his advantage and overcome the obstacles to escape as soon as possible.

title: Kokoro Space Opera Demo
description: In KOKORO SPACE OPERA join an all-girl squad of galactic fighter pilots as they try to save the Earth from assured destruction. Will this wacky space adventure get a happy ending? Or is this sci-fi story secretly a tragedy? Your choices decide their fate!

title: Crystalase Demo
description: Unlock new images, explore different themes, and enjoy the rewarding process of turning scattered crystals into dazzling masterpieces.

title: IT THINKS! - Build Your Own GPU Demo
description: Play a focused, shorter version of IT THINKS! Complete 12 contracts—from your first logic gate to an early taste of parallel GPU design—and carry your progress into the full game.

title: Mind Flowers Demo
description: You are a psychologist who works nights. The man across the desk has been institutionalized for nineteen years and does not want to leave. Talk, listen, take notes and then sign. The game will never tell you who was telling the truth.

title: Stellar Embers: United Fleet Demo
description: Stellar Embers: United Fleet is a real-time space combat game with flagship piloting, fleet command & roguelike growth. Pilot your ship, direct escorts, explore random systems, refit warships, recruit captains & build a mighty fleet via dynamic missions & co-op.

title: This is not Chess, It's War! Demo
变废为宝 Trash to Cash Demo
description: Trash to Cash – a satisfying, surprising incremental trash-diving game. Rummage for treasure, and maybe you'll become the next Trash King!

title: Kick The Piñata! Demo
description: Grab your trusty bat and smash piñatas in this colorful incremental game. Buy weapons, unlock upgrades, rebirth, and build your strangely arranged home. Everything is cute, everything is fine, and the piñatas are definitely not alive.

title: Skyscraper Security: Zombie Rain Demo
description: Defend a neon megacity from zombies raining from the sky in a fast first-person action roguelike. Try all four classes, bend time, build devastating upgrades, and survive the demo's seven escalating waves.

title: Voidrunners Demo
description: Voidrunners is a space bullet heaven where you combine unique weapons, equipment, and upgrades to create powerful builds. Explore maps filled with secrets, unlock new ships, and survive endless hordes of enemies.

title: Hold the Dawn Demo
description: Build by day. Survive the horde by night. Hold the Dawn is a 3D wasteland tower defense with unique auto-fighting heroes, tactical towers, zombie waves, and co-op over Steam, LAN, or local play.

title: Get-Out-Hoomanz Demo
description: Play the unhinged Demo now! Face your friends in chaotic 2-4 player matches. Build vicious dungeon layouts, test your survival skills, and prove you're not just another human snack. Free, infinite multiplayer mayhem awaits!

title: Divine Gambit Demo
description: Defy the Gods alone or with friends and defend your village in a unique blend of action and strategy. Gather resources, place traps and fortify your land by day. At night, wield mighty weapons and spells to repel the invading armies. Overcome impossible odds and become the Protector of your people!

title: The Plunge Of Sludge Demo
description: The Plunge Of Sludge is a 2D bullet hell roguelite where you collect trinkets, weapons, and hats from a pool of over 500+ items to conquer a dungeon and defeat THE KEEPER. You will fail and perish, but every attempt will be different and more chaotic than the last. Will you take the plunge?

title: Snot Pop! Demo
description: Play the free demo of Snot Pop! Trap, pop, and splat your way through the upper levels of the slime-choked sewers in this '90s-style vertical pixel platformer. Master your snot bubbles, outmanoeuvre the first wave of vile Mouldlings, chain your clears, and prepare for the full rescue mission!

title: Hardground Demo
description: Inherit your grandfather’s neglected ranch and turn it into a thriving farming empire. Raise animals, grow crops, produce valuable goods and build your dream ranch. Explore the countryside, fish, hunt, complete quests, and work your way towards becoming a millionaire.

title: Dodgeon Demo
description: The free demo of Dodgeon, a pure-dodge neon arcade game. Two powers, three enemy types, one arena: pick your matchup and survive the flood of projectiles as long as you can. Every run is ranked, with local and online leaderboards.

title: Decontamination Protocol Demo
description: Step behind the security terminal in this tense psychological game. Review shift directives, scan incoming personnel, and make life-or-death decisions. Trust no one, and quarantine every doubt before the contagion breaches the facility.

title: Enjoy Your Stay Demo
description: Navigate the never-ending hallway of the Hudson: A hotel that doesn’t want its guests to leave. Observe your surroundings, spot irregularities, and choose the correct path to escape.

title: Marimo-VS-IAS Demo
description: This is the free demo version of "Marimo-VS-IAS: Our Friends."You can play the first chapter, try some of the training content, and explore selected areas.

title: Emojis vs Zombies Demo
description: Emojis vs Zombies is an Idle Desktop Companion Zombie Defense Game! Open packs, Collect Emoji Defenders, Upgrade your squad or base and survive endless waves even while you're AFK or working!

title: 裂光のセリアーナ Demo
description: 裂光のセリアーナは、王道ファンタジー×ナンセンスコメディのSRPGです 総勢64名の個性的なキャラクターと多彩な成長要素を駆使してステージを攻略していきます メインストーリー49マップ、エクストラマップ9マップの全58を、愉快な仲間と共に駆け抜けましょう ※体験版では合計12マップまでプレイ可能となっています※

title: Stellar End Demo
description: Free Demo version includes 4 missions, about 25% of the full version! Cool combination of classic Sci-Fi 2D "Shoot 'em up" with FPP rail shooter.

title: The Last Pillar: Hajj Demo
description: A cleaning sim unlike anything you've played before. Brush, restore and power wash your way through the sacred days of Hajj.

title: Rain of Lead Demo
description: Every hit is lethal, with no room for error. Switch between sword and pistol to tear through soldiers, artillery pieces, tanks — and even destroy an entire army. You awaken without memories. A queen claiming to be your wife asks you to fight for her. Will you stand with her to the end?

title: 廃人メダルゲーマーが勝負を挑んで来た！～メダルタワー編～ Demo
description: Let's play some medal games with your classmate, the hardcore medal game addict! But your classmate is obsessed with racking up medals. Let's show them the joy of just playing for fun.

title: ShootAndJump Demo
description: Every shot comes with recoil! This is the only rule. Survive first, then defeat more enemies. Plan each move carefully—every shot you take matters. Whether you can break through the enemy's encirclement and escape depends entirely on your skill.

title: REOGUNA Demo
description: This is the demo version of "REOGUNA." You can try out the tutorial, the early stages, and a portion of the level editor. Stage completion data can be carried over to the full version.

title: Revenant Survivors Demo
description: Revenant Survivors is a horde survival action roguelite set in a Diablo-inspired dark fantasy world. Tear through endless hordes with hard-hitting combat, absorb souls, and steal bosses' skills—even their bodies—to become evil incarnate.

title: HordeFall Demo
description: A bulletheaven x incremental game that runs as a desktop companion in the corner of your screen! While you work, your hero automatically fights thousands of enemies. Unlock upgrades and manage your economy, attributes, and spells. Your screen is your battlefield - minimal space, maximum progress!

title: Kona & SnowRabbit Demo
description: The mischievous art duo, Kona and SnowRabbit, rise to fame by pranking veteran artists until the furious “Palette Gang” strikes back. With their home in ruins, the two troublemakers set out to reclaim their stolen pride and masterpieces.

title: TimeslotTV Demo
description: TimeslotTV is personal media software that organizes your video, audio, and image files into a simulated live television experience. Create a lineup, get comfortable and channel surf to a simpler time. This is the DEMO version.

title: IJIN: History Survivors Demo
description: A Bullet Heaven fought with history's great figures — this is the demo. One figure, one battlefield: survive fifteen minutes against the horde. You only move; attacks fire on their own. All you choose is the mix of weapons and passives. Record and gold carry into the full game.

title: 阿宅的我被二次元女同事搭讪了！ Demo
description: （本作根据真实事件改编） 你是一名刚毕业的程序员阿宅，入职第一天就被二次元女同事七海强势搭讪，这位爱捉弄你的可爱坏女人，用各种甜蜜伎俩猛攻你的心房！游戏拥有29个HappyEnd，从嘴硬到心动，你能扛过几轮攻势？宅男与同事的恋爱日常，就这样开始啦！

title: IncreTop Demo
description: IncreTop is an incremental game about whipping spinning tops. You're trapped in a world of nothing but tops — whip them, earn money, upgrade, learn skills, and find a way to escape.

title: The Pink Robot Demo
description: The Pink Robot is a fast-paced isometric action roguelite with deep build variety and fluid combat. Create powerful synergies through skills and mementos, and face relentless challenges that grow stronger with every run.

title: Plague Genesis Demo
description: A 2D survival horror game in which you explore forests and dark locations, face terrifying infected creatures, and uncover the truth behind a devastating biological catastrophe.

title: Chroma Keyboard Demo
description: Four tracks and one fifteen-minute Epic from Chroma Keyboard: a calm four-key rhythm game with no fail state, where every run plays to the last note. Twelve tones folded onto four keys, each keeping its own colour.

title: 魅魔深渊：三十天生存法则 Demo
description: "魅魔深渊：三十天生存法则"是一款卡牌养成roguelike游戏。玩家可以自由组建自己的队伍，挑战不同的BOSS，拯救异世界的人民。

title: Project OC Demo
description: Project OC is a multiplayer online desktop idle game. Unlock 1000+ customization options through idle gameplay and freely mix appearances, outfits, expressions, and actions to create your unique OC.

title: Hand Stretched Demo
description: Behind the warm bricks is a tight game of precision and margins. Try your hand at managing the kitchen alone in this free single-player demo, locked to Level 1 on Easy Mode. If you enjoy the shift, please wishlist the full game for up to 3-player co-op and 6-player, 3v3 play. Steamdeck compatible!

title: Evoruption Demo
description: A dark roguelike deckbuilder where you build and evolve powerful decks, battle corrupted creatures, and master new mechanics across handcrafted story campaigns — or challenge other players in tactical 1v1 and 2v2 battles.

title: HauntedHouseNO14 Demo
description: HauntedHouseNO14 is a first‑person psychological horror game offering an immersive terrifying experience. Investigate an old unsolved case, encounter all sorts of uncanny and bizarre occurrences, and gradually unearth the dark truth that has been covered up.

title: Waifu Factory Demo
description: This is a factory game where you manage a factory creating waifus to complete requests, buy upgrades and to grow your factory to spread love to the world.

title: Auto Cats Demo
description: Auto Cats is a tactical deckbuilding roguelite where your cats never attack on their own—every hit is a card you play. Build a team, position cats on a 6×6 grid, and battle through the complete first act in this demo.

title: GHOSTNOTE Demo
description: Do The Drums Call You?Apparently when they're haunted they do.While cleaning out the attic, you find a haunted machine that plays the drums, but you have to push the right buttons for it to work. Play the notes, take the stage, set them free...

title: Aftergrowth Demo
description: Begin your journey in this focused single-player demo. Gather wood, build a simple timber shelter, and follow the road to Millbrook, the first nearby town. No upgrades—just the bare essentials of survival and building.

title: Emoji Massacre Demo
description: The free demo: fight your way to your first belt.This is the opening act of EMOJI MASSACRE — a top-down boxing game where every fighter is an emoji, and every emoji has a pair of gloves to match.WHAT YOU GET 🥊 The whole fight system, untouched — jabs, hooks, uppercuts, blocks, dodges and frame-tight parries.

title: Welcome to the Syndicate Demo
description: Rise to infamy through hits, heists, and upheaval as you build and manage your own mob of femme fatales in 1930s NYC. Will you be able to succeed against the odds and fight for those who cannot?

title: Renz Village Adventure Demo
description: An idle village simulation RPG where you build a thriving town, recruit unique heroes, send adventurers into dangerous dungeons, and watch your village grow into a legendary kingdom.

title: Flippy the Spider Demo
description: Jump, glide, and swing your way through increasingly challenging levels, eating flies and searching for your way home. Master tight, physics-based controls, explore the world, and collect trophies along the way!

title: Last Buzz Demo
description: Last Buzz is a 2–6 player Humans vs. Flies multiplayer game. Steal food, crawl on ceilings, hide in stupid places, and rescue your friends as a fly—or grab the bug spray, lock down the house, and hunt the little bastards before they take over.

title: Fathom Reach Demo
description: A roguelike deckbuilder where every run is a raid. Dive the drowned deep, build your deck on the way down, and crack a fortified base at the bottom. Free demo, unlimited dives.

title: Forsaken Fleet Demo
description: A first-person pirate horror where a haunted fisherman is drawn into the legend of the Forsaken Fleet. Follow a mysterious compass. Sail through the fog. Explore forgotten places and survive the horrors that should have stayed buried at sea.

title: Powder Inc. Demo
description: DEMO: Build a skier's Valhalla or gouge it into MEGA Resort Inc. Balance the books, weather the storms, and keep pace as the mountain demands more. The yeti's real, and it's judging you. A ski resort tycoon based on real world ski development business model, with a taste of mountain culture

title: God, Save the Queens! Demo
description: You are God. The king’s five daughters have been taken. Fight thousands of enemies, unlock powerful skills, and defeat the evil wizard Zaharad in this brutal 2.5D roguelike!

title: Super Duper Siege Demo
description: Build, defend, and upgrade your kingdom in Super Duper Siege! A tower defense roguelike where you must survive an endless onslaught from the forces of darkness.

title: 771 Demo
description: "771" is a first-person psychological horror game consisting of 7 unique gameplay segments, each created by a different developer.
developer: Admia, a1esska, 1ne2wozzz, POS, ranwoG, xetoN, MrGD

title: SANASANA Demo
description: To bring her deceased sister back to life, a young girl sets out to steal the Golden Apples from three witches. Dodge beautiful yet merciless bullet patterns in this dark fantasy bullet hell shooter filled with madness.

title: Glitch Hunter: L-Virus Outbreak Demo
description: Glitch Hunter: L-Virus Outbreak is a roguelike deckbuilder set inside a corrupted simulation. The mysterious L-Virus has infected the game world, breaking its data and turning everything into distorted low-poly fragments. Monsters, environments, and even the rules of reality have been rewritten.

title: The Die Rules All Armies: Three Kingdoms Demo
PAY THE HOUSE Demo
description: You owe The House 1,400, and the only trade you have is cigarette cards. Rip packs, complete sets, and cover a payment that comes due every two days. This demo is the whole first layer of the debt — and the first trinket you buy to survive the second. Your progress carries over.

title: God of Chaos Demo
description: Defy nature’s laws and avenge your slain pantheon! When you awake from a thousand-year slumber, will you liberate humanity or let the world burn?

title: Carom Crashers Demo
description: Bank shots beat direct hits — ×1.5 off one wall, ×2 off two. A 4-player party shooter where you read angles like billiards. Couch party: plug in a pad, press A; friends join free via Remote Play Together. Full bot matches, online quick match, 12 weapons, 6 arenas, mutators.

title: Sea Beast Odyssey Demo
description: An incremental action game set across the seas. Lead a party of 5 Heroes, upgrade your heroes and mounts, unlock 16 powerful skills, and build your skill tree as you fight through 35 levels of sea monsters. Defeat giant bosses and tame them as mounts for your next adven

title: Wild Boar Digging Demo
description: A small relaxing game where you control a wild boar collecting resources. Upgrade the attributes of you wild boar and find a diversity of interesting animal cards. You can even recruit bees to help you!

title: Thorn Beach Demo
description: DEMO — An animated puzzle from Thorn Beach! Relax while piecing together a cozy slice-of-life jigsaw featuring characters and creatures from myth and folklore.

title: BROODHOUSE Demo
description: Your deck is alive and it breeds. A creature card hits for its whole strain's population, so your power sits in the cards you never draw. The demo is one complete run — five layers, a boss, and the specimen sheet you get for finishing. 25 to 40 minutes, free.

title: Radiorizon Demo
description: Dash into this challenging 2D platformer where you visit the remains of an old star system. You cannot fight the hostile creatures, only the god-like entities that sense danger in your presence. Explore the dangerous environment, talk to the inhabitants and destroy all 3 planets to save humanity.

title: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE DEMO
description: Begin your journey with the free demo where your saved data carries over to the full game! While some level restrictions apply, you can freely explore the entire first chapter exactly as it appears in the full version.

title: Dr. Oops! Demo
description: Treat bizarre patients, solve outrageous medical mysteries, and pay off your crushing debt in this dark comedy deduction adventure! Every diagnosis relies on your observation, deduction, and some real-world knowledge. Pay off your debt, or skip a payment if needed, and fight for your freedom.

title: Stupid Never Dies: First Bite Demo
description: Turn weak zombie Davy stupid strong, stupid fast in this Blazing Fast Growth action RPG! Devour enemies, steal powers, transform, and brave a deadly dungeon to revive frozen Julia.

title: SlashZero Demo
description: SlashZero is a side-scrolling action roguelike game. As a Timehacker, your job is to travel across timelines and explore a cyberpunk world, use combat skills and strategies to piece together the truth, and take down the Lord of the Void! Is what you see the truth?

title: Emberbound Demo
description: EMBERBOUND is a furry visual novel about returning home, reuniting with old friends, and promises left unfinished. Back in his hometown to handle matters concerning his family’s old house, Yunxi faces the regrets and feelings that never truly faded.

title: Endless Mall Demo
description: Endless Mall is a roguelike city-builder card game. Carefully select your shops, mind your layout, build a powerful economic engine, and rake in profits beyond your wildest imagination!

title: More Slots More Money Demo
description: A short incremental casino management game where you fill the floor with slot machines and table games, hire staff, expand to new rooms, and upgrade towards the ultimate automated casino.

title: My Fairy Princess Demo
description: My Fairy Princess is a life sim set in an Eastern fantasy world, featuring multiple endings. You take on the role of a parent, raising your daughter in a fabled realm of spiritual beauty and tranquility. How will you guide your daughter into an uncertain future?

title: Astral Enterprises Demo
description: As CEO, build a ruthless corporate empire! Solve spatial factory puzzles, master complex supply chains, and manipulate dynamic markets to maximise profit. Mobilise local workforces, fund high-tech R&D, and construct colossal megaprojects to satisfy your demanding Parent Company.

title: Fall, Fall, Fall for you Demo
Swarm Harvest Demo
description: Congratulations, you're hired! Blast bugs, deploy defensive towers, and command a pack of powerful attack drones to carve through endless alien swarms. Evolve into an unstoppable bug-blasting machine with absurdly overpowered builds to generate massive profits and make the corporation proud.

title: 世外桃源 Demo
description: 这是一款夜店模拟经营游戏，但是无需对店铺进行管理，而是着重于满足顾客的需求。每个顾客有需求和偏好，只有满足需求的员工才可以接待这名顾客，如果满足了偏好则可以获得额外的打赏。 商业竞争：和其它夜店进行PK，获胜可获得新员工和服装。 丰富的服装：每个员工都有漂亮的服装，可随时更换，同时顾客偏好也有服装，穿着相应的服装可以获得打赏。

title: Boom Boom No Guess Minesweeper DEMO
description: Classic MineSweeper meets intense dungeon combat! Explore mysterious magic towers, encounter bizarre monsters, and collect powerful items. Featuring unique mine-sweeping battle mechanics, every step of deduction is crucial!

title: Fly&Goal Demo
description: A casual puzzle game where you play disc golf while navigating holes that showcase the changing seasons. Read the wind to choose your throw, dodge obstacles, and aim to clear all 12 courses, each with 9 holes.

title: PHAGE Demo
description: "Phage" is a pixel-art platformer. Players control a weak primitive organism called the "Phage", whose only ability is to steal the bodies of other creatures on the map—each with unique traits and powers.

title: Match-3 Live Stream Demo
description: Match-3 Live Stream is a roguelike game where you play as a streamer. Dance on stream, earn likes, follows, donations and other rewards by matching tiles, and collect new viewers and other pieces to build your deck. Each piece has a unique function.

title: SOGUL: Den of the Deep Demo
Backlot: Hollywood Studio Tycoon Demo
description: A deep Hollywood studio simulation, 1930 to the streaming age. A back lot, a million dollars and no pictures. Commission scripts, sign stars to seven-year contracts, book dates against rival studios, and survive television, home video and everything else that came for the movies.

title: Temple 13 - Time Collapse Demo
description: A first-person game where you explore a mysterious ancient temple and search for anomalies. Carefully observe your surroundings, spot changes, and determine what has changed. As you progress, the anomalies become increasingly dangerous, leading you deeper into a mysterious labyrinth.

title: Strange Tales from Republican China Demo
description: The demo includes the game's prologue and is available for free.

title: Valorwood (Early Access) Demo
description: Valorwood is a multiverse fantasy survival RPG built in Unreal Engine 5. Explore the Overworld, battle enemies, mine gemstones, craft, build bases and fly broomsticks. This Alpha showcases the core game while characters, animations and future realms remain in development.

title: Cirtemin Demo
description: Prove your worth on the endless battlefield—as long as someone is still standing, the fight goes on.

title: HEARKEN Demo
description: A blind co-op horror-comedy for 2-4 players. Sound is your only sight — every whisper, footstep, and shout lights up the dark, and calls the monster that hunts by ear. Sneak, haul cargo, and scream at exactly the wrong moment.

title: Eternal Rift Defense Demo
description: The first eleven rifts of Eternal Rift Defense, free and fully offline. Play a hero on the field, raise your towers, hunt your first gear, and hold the line against Vaelgrym's legions. No account, no connection, no catch.

title: 墨守 Demo
description: 東洋ハイファンタジーの世界で、防衛成功まで何度も時を巻き戻す高難易度２Ｄタワーディフェンス。 さらにゲーム内のステージ作成機能により、プレイヤーの数だけ終わりないステージが待っている。 デモ版でも20時間以上遊べるボリュームたっぷりなゲーム。

title: Paint The World Demo
description: Everything starts white. The buildings, the streets, the trees, the cars parked at the curb - a whole little town with no color in it. What you do about that is up to you.You point at something and paint the exact spot you're looking at, and the color stays. Simple enough. But paint a tree all the way and it starts swaying in the wind.

title: Puzzle Loot Demo
description: A 7×7 tap puzzle roguelite RPG. Defeat monsters by clearing blocks, choose from 25 classes, collect and forge gear, and reincarnate through New Game+ toward the Demon Lord's Castle and beyond. Easy to pick up, deep enough to master, with a bounty system that changes how you play.

title: Bato Battle Demo
description: Bato Battle is a chaotic submarine party combat game for 2-8 players. Pilot a whale, ram a shark, dive like a dolphin, and torpedo your friends across a pile of ridiculous gamemodes and maps!

title: Sluice That Goose! Demo
description: An incremental game where you sluice huge flocks of gooses and farm their loot to further enhance your goose sluicing behaviors. Unlock powerful upgrades, discover hidden events, and SLUICE. MORE. GOOSE.

title: Magic Chess - 魔法象棋 Demo
BATTLEFRONTS: GRIMDARK Demo
description: Mostly same gameplay than the core paid game, just with less aesthetic options.

title: TCG Card Chaos Demo
description: Organize hundreds of collectible cards scattered throughout a chaotic card shop. Inspect their types, rarities, numbers, and symbols, open card packs, discover graded cards, and find the right place for every card.

title: BloodState Demo
description: An elite military team is sent to recover a specimen that could change everything. As the sole survivor, you must restore power, unlock new routes, reactivate critical systems, and uncover why someone wanted the mission buried.

title: Crowns of Medieval Europe Demo
description: Starting in the year 1401, Crowns of Medieval Europe is a turn-based grand strategy game. Lead one of 10 historical kingdoms, manage your resources, purchase vital goods from the market, master diplomacy, and march your armies to unify 15th-century Europe!

title: Skippy's Grand Escape Demo
description: Escape increasingly complex mazes as fast as possible. Select skills tactically for each level. Optimize your path. Watch out for enemies, traps, anomalies and more in this space themed top down maze runner.

title: Tiny Garden Café Demo
description: Sow seeds and nurture them, harvest fresh ingredients to cook meals, and serve them to your guests. As the seasons turn and dusk falls, the café lights glow—enjoy a peaceful day in your very own little garden café.

title: Stories of Somnia Demo
description: Stories of Somnia is an exploration-first JRPG with the bones of a Metroidvania. Use spells to grapple across gaps, change the rules of combat, and reshape the world around you. Collect memory-born companions called Dreamkin and uncover a story about grief, time, and the courage to rest.

title: I Opened an Idle Bar So I Can GOON to HOT GIRLS Demo
Lone Tower Demo
description: Defend one tower. Face endless waves. Build synergies, unlock permanent upgrades, and survive the chaos.

title: Unseen Beings Demo
description: Avoid or confront invisible entities while exploring, solving puzzles, and overcoming horrors to to pay off your debt. Use special goggles, a taser gun, and your wits to survive the night.

title: Solitaire: Kingdom in Chains Demo
description: A dark fairytale solitaire adventure. Help Patch break Mordrake’s curse across 90 handcrafted levels, defeat bizarre bosses, wield magical powers, and unlock beautiful decks, card backs and worlds along the way.

title: Untold Memories: Obsession Demo
description: Play as police officer Nathan Mercer in a story-driven psychological horror game. Explore a quiet home, uncover disturbing clues, piece together the events of the night, and unravel the mystery before the past closes in.

title: Warehouse Bots Demo
description: Get an early look at Warehouse Bots with this free demo. Build your first warehouse, organize storage, unlock basic licenses, and manage a growing fleet of delivery robots.The demo includes the opening campaign levels and a small sandbox where you can experiment with layouts, traffic flow, and automation.

title: KABUKI FIRE: DOJO Demo
description: Score as many points as possible within a limited time frame and break the global high-score in this charming but challenging arcade shoot 'em up!!

title: WILDERLOCKE Demo
description: WILDERLOCKE is a tactical monster-taming roguelike. Build up a team of diverse & powerful monsters. Find the perfect combinations of moves, passives & stats to create devastating synergies. Triumph in increasingly challenging 2v2 turn-based battles and become unstoppable.

title: PUGAD Demo
description: PUGAD is a spearfishing horror game set on a secluded island in the Philippines. As a newbie diver, learn to hunt fish, upgrade your equipment, hone your diving skills, and discover what lurks in the depths.

title: Renewed: Create Sustainable Power Demo
description: Renewed: Create Sustainable Power is a first-person simulation game where players build and manage their own renewable energy community through the design, construction, and configuration of battery systems, solar infrastructure, and sustainable power networks.

title: Shatterswarm Demo
description: The Voxan Empire bears it's iron teeth and sends fleet after fleet of terrifying space abominations at you. Defend your colony. Defend humanity!

title: Terminidle Demo
description: Terminidle is an incremental hacking game about mining data from a bare terminal. Grow botnets, automate everything, and run hack contracts under a timer. This demo runs from your very first byte to the moment your terminal boots a desktop OS.

title: Ashrose Manor - A Portrait of Forbidden Love Demo
No Death No Life Demo
description: A demo of an existential horror visual novel that lets the player experience how immortality would affect their relationships.

title: Soul Link - End and Rebirth Demo
PROXY Demo
description: Battle through a chaotic, high-tech alien world in this fast-paced top-down roguelike shooter – with friends or solo. Master intense bullet-hell combat and stack unique items to unleash devastating, game-breaking combos.

title: 仙路烟尘 Demo
description: Path of Immortal Dust is a text-based cultivation sim. Train your techniques, break through realms, and explore a world of sect politics and turn-based combat. Every action costs time. Every choice shapes your fate. Immortality is but a thought away.

title: Another Eden Begins Demo
description: Embark on a time-traveling RPG adventure featuring command battles presented by Masato Kato, creator of numerous RPG classics.

title: Ironholm: Reign of the Isles Demo
Bad Pig House Demo
description: You lost your piggy family... Rebuild your home to stay safe.

title: RoadsBeneathTheCrownDemo
description: Travel between five distinct cities, trade across shifting markets, gather intelligence, bid at auctions, explore the black market, research rare artifacts, and hire specialists to strengthen your enterprise. In Roads Beneath the Crown, every deal and decision shapes the merchant you become.

title: 緋修羅 HIJURA SCARLET GEAR Demo
description: This is a free demo for "HIJURA SCARLET GEAR". In this demo, you can play the early stage and experience the core action gameplay.

title: The Fog Below Demo
description: An ASCII-style endless arcade crawler. Using a unique Minesweeper-inspired reveal mechanic to navigate random generated dungeons while engaging in frantic, high-speed arcade combat.

title: TOWERTOWER Demo
description: Stack. Mislead. Wipe them out. A punishing tower defense about building a fortress out of stacked blocks. Every tower is a weapon, a wall, and a piece of terrain that leads enemies astray. Let 50 through and it is over.

title: Ashen Demo
description: ASHEN is a top-down pixel art action RPG set after a solar apocalypse. Dodge and chain attacks against creatures born from the Cinder, forge your build with no fixed class, then farm, fish and cook to rebuild what's left of Braseval.

title: Demon Baby Demo
description: Play the first day of the full game in either story mode, arcade mode or speedrun mode

title: Wasteland Future Demo
description: The apocalypse has come, and the world has become a silent graveyard. Seek powerful companions, and unleash their abilities through the dice in your hand. Roll a hopeful future.

title: Risel of the Slave City Demo
NIGHT DEVOURESS Demo
description: Casual Horror Action RPG "NIGHT DEVOURESS" – Exorcism? Physical is trending!

title: Crooked Derby Demo
description: Bet in secret, lie in public, and rig the race. Play a free demo of Crooked Derby, a turn-based digital board game of bluffing, deduction, and underhanded horse-race manipulation.

title: Frontier Tale Demo
description: Frontier Tale is a cozy adventure farming game that blends extraction-style gameplay with town building. Forge weapons, explore a charming cel-shaded fantasy world, gather rare resources, recruit unique companions, and build your dream frontier from the ground up.

title: STEEL GULLET Demo
description: Build a massive factory aboard a moving ark. Melt, separate, and refine chaotic scrap using realistic thermodynamics. Process materials by mass instead of items, craft based on material properties, and optimize complex production lines in strictly limited space.

title: Tactical Tile Breaker Incremental Demo
description: A synthwave space tile‑breaker. Hit the ball. Stack powerup cards at the right moments to clear the screen in the fastest time. Or just chill and space out to the synthwave soundtrack beats.

title: Otherealm Demo
description: Story-driven AVG with puzzles and multiple endings. Trapped in a twisted otherworld high school, survive deadly divine trials. Explore locations, collect clues to uncover dark campus secrets amid lies and betrayal. Your choices shift bonds, expose truths and decide who survives.

title: Vanguard's Descent Demo
description: A rogue-like RPG focused on player teambuilding, dungeon progression, and a unique spin on action combat. Recruit members of the Vanguard, humanity's last hope and journey across various lands to defeat the evil that is the Plagued.

title: Adverse Action Demo
